targets.review_note: A spell is point(mana rate,damage rate); idle is(0,0). Mixing spells over total time is a convex combination, so maximum damage under mana bound is the increasing upper convex hull, followed by a constant plateau at maximumdamage. Online insertion removes dominated and nonconcave points, each at mostonce. Fenwick orderedset on the declared integer mana-rate universe supplies neighbors; comparisons use integer crossproducts. A fight uses its two bracketing hull points and an exact rational crossmultiplication. Decode each query with index of last successful fight, not count ofwins. Independent oracle enumerates every one/two-spell LP extreme point and idle for small streams; stress includes100k dynamic updates.
